name: capital-stack-finterminal
description: Capital-Stack-FinTerminal: the Capital area's capital-markets terminal as an Android app behind the SuperApp's Cloud > Lnktree row. Six tabs on the shared bottom nav, FI | EQ | EX | NW | PM | MY-PM, each entry a dashboard drawn from a DECLARED source (data/sources.json): Cloud-Fincept / fin_api on the private mesh first (with a Start / Stop / Restart control for its container), the key-free public sources (FRED, DBnomics, IMF, World Bank, GDELT) as fallback, and dashed placeholders where a source needs a key you add in Config > Sources (stored encrypted on the phone). MY-PM is a simple local holdings list. Every figure shown is what its source returned, with its date and attribution.

auto_update._doc_max_installs_per_pass: Most install sessions ONE unattended background pass may open. A background pass cannot show the system install dialog (Android 10+ blocks background activity starts), so each install it starts leaves a tap-to-install notification holding a PackageInstaller session until the user answers it. Unbounded, one pass over the 40-entry fleet opens 40 and the installer hits Android's 50-session cap - 'Too many active sessions for UID'. The remainder is picked up by the next pass. User-initiated 'Update all' is NOT capped: it runs in the foreground where the dialog appears and sessions resolve at once.
auto_update._doc_enabled: Off because this app compiles no libs:updater: the Store updates it, as it does Cloud Calc and Cloud Search.

ui._doc: #868 THE nav declaration (libs:bottomnav NavDecl) of Capital-Stack-FinTerminal: the sections on the bottom bar in order, a hidden Config (the gear of the first row: Sources, About) and a hidden About. #1335 ui.stacks[<section>] is the page of that section: a list of entries drawn by declared KIND (Pages.kt: entry, section_title, holdings, about, dashboard, sources). A `dashboard` entry (every FinTerm entry) has a title, a one-line subtitle and `dashboard`, the id of its dashboard in data/dashboards.json; the dashboard names its declared source(s) in data/sources.json (the catalog, with endpoints, auth, coverage and the tabs/entries each source feeds), so no address is typed in this file or in Kotlin. The `sources` kind is Config > Sources: the catalog by category and the user's own API keys, stored encrypted on the phone. An `entry` (still drawn for the other Lnktree apps' shape) has ONE declared source for its target: `site` (the label of a link of aa_cloud-superapp/data/linktree.json), `registry` (a code of aa_cloud-superapp/build.json ui.app_urls.registry_sites) or `repo` + `path`; app/build.gradle resolves them at BUILD time from the SuperApp's own declarations and bakes UI_TARGETS_B64. A `planned` entry has a note and no source and is drawn greyed. Market figures are never declared here: a dashboard shows what its source returns, with its date and attribution. #1722 every sub-page and detail page carries `fn`, its function mnemonic: the command line (amber field + GO) opens a page by it. `perf_portfolio` is a performance portfolio (data/portfolios.json group `view`): its constituents and weights are the runtime dataset perf-portfolios, its figures the quote source's; FI is the bond groups (All | Gov Bonds DM | Gov Bonds EM | AAA | AA-A | BBB | Junk), the rates, macro and credit pages that were under FI are under CB, EQ is Performance (the factor portfolios) and Data.

about.tagline: A capital-markets terminal from declared sources
about.description: Capital-Stack-FinTerminal is the Capital area's capital-markets terminal on the phone. Six tabs — fixed income, equities, FX, news, portfolio management and the owner's portfolio — each draw dashboards from a declared source: the Fincept / fin_api service on the private mesh first (with Start, Stop and Restart for its container), and key-free public sources such as FRED, DBnomics, the IMF, the World Bank and GDELT as fallback. It exists so market data the owner follows is read from sources that are declared and checkable, with a visible placeholder where a source is missing.
features: FI, EQ and EX market dashboards
Each panel from a declared source
Mesh first, public sources as fallback
Start, stop or restart the data container
guide: Join the private mesh so the fin_api source answers.
Open a tab; panels show where each number comes from.
Use Config to restart the data container if panels are empty.
about.privacy: No ads and no third-party trackers. A crash report is saved on the phone and sent only to the phone's own C3 WebServer over loopback; nothing leaves the device unless you share it. It talks only to the fleet services listed below, over the private mesh first.

perms._doc: #1360 every grant this app needs, by libs:perms catalogue id (needs), and the fleet apps that do work for it with the grants THEY must hold (helpers). The ONE declaration: generated into assets/app-perms.json (cloud-android-perms-guard.py --write), drawn by Configs > General > Perms (libs:perms AppPermsSection) with live state, Grant / Open and Grant all, asked at first run (first_run), and reported as 'Missing permission X - Grant' when an operation fails (PermsGate). perms-guard fails when code uses a gated API or another app's engine that is not declared here, or when the manifest and this list disagree.
